summary: The recorded base reproduces the original non-first-stage mHC KeyError because the runner supplies only folded hidden_states while GLM5 unconditionally reads residual. The exact candidate aligns GLM5 input and output proxy keys with that existing runner contract and preserves non-mHC behavior. Focused regression, buffer allocation tests, and independent adversarial GPU cases passed. Full three-GPU NVIDIA model serving was unavailable, but no remaining source-level counterexample was found for the reported contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution of the candidate regression against the exact recorded base: the mHC hidden_states-only proxy raised KeyError: 'residual'; the other two cases passed.
Three focused GLM5 cases passed, including the original mHC boundary and the separate non-mHC residual boundary.
All 41 runner buffer-registry tests passed, including mHC/non-mHC pipeline proxy allocation behavior.
Candidate GPU fixture preserved expected mHC and non-mHC proxy keys and values on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-39c164ad9192/venv/bin/python <independent inline adversarial proxy test> (candidate checkout)
tests.what_was_measured: Independently verified mHC hidden-only input, extraneous-residual stripping, non-mHC tensor round-trip, and rejection of a missing non-mHC residual on gfx950.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate and independent proxy-contract tensor checks ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, reported by PyTorch as gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so full model warmup and semantic accuracy were not tested.
Only one assigned GPU was available, so an actual pp_size > 1 server topology could not be launched.
The review GPU was AMD gfx950; the original report used three NVIDIA SM120 GPUs, so backend-specific full-server integration was not reproduced.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was neither required nor performed.
The tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify the GLM5 mHC architecture or a multi-stage pipeline handoff.
